successDesc: All your videos have been successfully rendered and mixed safely into the folder!
successDescSpectrum: Your audio spectrum has been successfully rendered safely into the folder!
info_namingDesc: If you leave this empty, the output files will follow the names of your original videos. If you type a custom name like 'my_video', the outputs will be named 'my_video 1.mp4', 'my_video 2.mp4', etc.
info_compressionDesc: The smaller the size, the lower the image quality. High Quality uses the least compression, while Small Size compresses heavily for faster upload times.
info_hwaccelDesc: VidMix automatically detects if your system has a dedicated GPU (Nvidia/AMD/Intel QuickSync) or relies on CPU. Using GPU makes rendering much faster.
info_musicOrderDesc: SHUFFLE (RANDOM): Every single output video will automatically get a completely different music track order using the Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm. CUSTOM ORDER: Every output video will get the exact same music order that you set manually.
guideSpectrumDesc: Automatically create audio visualizations from your music files.
guideMixerStep1: 1. Select one or multiple Videos/Photos as the base background. (Supports drag & drop)
guideMixerStep2: 2. Select one or multiple Background Music files. (Supports drag & drop)
guideMixerStep3: 3. Select the output destination folder to save the generated videos.
guideMixerStep4: 4. Configure compression quality, hardware acceleration, and output naming as desired.
guideMixerStep5: 5. Select the music shuffle setting (Random or Custom Sequence) and click 'START GENERATING'.
guideSpectrumStep1: 1. Drag & drop a music file (MP3/WAV) into the Spectrum Maker input box.
guideSpectrumStep2: 2. Select an output folder to store the rendered visualization video.
guideSpectrumStep3: 3. Configure the visualizer settings: Bar/Waveform shape, colors, and add an optional logo.
guideSpectrumStep4: 4. Preview the audio by clicking Play, adjust settings, and click 'START RENDERING'.
guideRemoveBgStep1: 1. Drag & drop a photo into the Remove BG input box.
guideRemoveBgStep2: 2. Select an output folder for the result.
guideRemoveBgStep3: 3. Click 'REMOVE BACKGROUND' and wait for the AI to process.
